projects.title: Multi-tenant SaaS dashboard for a logistics startup
projects.problem: each customer got a hand-patched copy of the app and onboarding took a week
projects.approach: a single multi-tenant Next.js app with tenant-scoped queries, role-based permissions and self-serve onboarding
outcomes: new customer onboarding from 5 days to 20 minutes
infrastructure cost per tenant down 60%
projects.review: one codebase instead of twelve forks, finally

projects.title: Stripe subscriptions and billing portal
projects.problem: manual invoicing and failed card payments nobody noticed
projects.approach: Stripe Billing with plan upgrades, proration, dunning emails and webhook handlers that are safe to retry
outcomes: involuntary churn down 23% after dunning
zero duplicate charges since launch
projects.review: billing just works and we stopped chasing invoices

projects.title: Real-time delivery tracking with WebSockets
projects.problem: customers phoned support to ask where their rider was
projects.approach: rider apps stream GPS over WebSockets, fanned out through Redis to customer apps with live ETA
outcomes: 'where is my order' calls down 46%
location updates delivered under 1 s p95
projects.review: the live map cut our support calls almost in half

projects.title: Headless Shopify storefront rebuild
projects.problem: a theme-based store scored 31 on mobile Lighthouse and lost shoppers on slow pages
projects.approach: a headless Next.js storefront with incremental static regeneration, image optimisation and a Shopify checkout
outcomes: mobile Lighthouse score from 31 to 94
conversion rate up 19% month over month
projects.review: the site is fast now and sales followed

projects.title: Django REST API for a clinic appointment system
projects.problem: double-booked appointments and no reminders, so 30% of patients no-showed
projects.approach: a booking API with slot locking, SMS reminders sent from a worker queue and an admin panel for front desks
outcomes: no-show rate from 30% to 12%
double bookings eliminated
projects.review: reliable and the reminders changed our no-show rate

projects.title: Internal admin panel with granular permissions
projects.problem: ops staff had database access to fix customer issues, which failed a compliance review
projects.approach: a React admin panel on a NestJS API with attribute-based permissions and an append-only audit trail
outcomes: direct production database access removed for 40 staff
passed the follow-up compliance audit
projects.review: compliance was happy and ops actually like the tool

projects.title: Marketing site and CMS migration to a headless CMS
projects.problem: volunteers could not update a WordPress site without breaking the layout
projects.approach: a Sanity-backed Next.js site with structured content, English/Urdu localisation and WCAG AA checks
outcomes: content edits by non-developers went from 0 to about 30 a month
page weight down 70%
projects.review: our volunteers can update the site themselves

projects.title: GraphQL API gateway consolidating three legacy services
projects.problem: the mobile app made 14 REST calls to render one booking screen
projects.approach: a GraphQL gateway with batched resolvers and response caching in front of the legacy services
outcomes: booking screen load time from 3.8 s to 1.1 s
API calls per screen from 14 to 1
projects.review: the app feels twice as fast

projects.title: CI/CD pipeline and containerised deployment
projects.problem: deploys were manual SSH sessions that broke production every few weeks
projects.approach: containerised the app, wrote Terraform for the AWS stack and a GitHub Actions pipeline with blue-green releases
outcomes: deploy time from 45 minutes to 8 minutes
no failed deploy reached users in six months
projects.review: we deploy daily now without fear

projects.title: Booking marketplace MVP for home services
projects.problem: the founders needed a working two-sided marketplace to raise a seed round
projects.approach: an MVP with provider onboarding, location-based search, split payments and reviews in 12 weeks
outcomes: launched with 180 providers in two cities
the company raised its seed round on the MVP
projects.review: delivered the MVP on time and it held up during the launch

projects.title: Accessibility remediation for a government portal
projects.problem: a citizen portal failed a WCAG 2.1 AA audit with 212 issues
projects.approach: fixed semantic markup, keyboard flows and contrast, then added automated accessibility checks to CI
outcomes: audit issues from 212 to 6
screen-reader task completion up from 40% to 95%
projects.review: thorough and explained every fix to our team

projects.title: Chrome extension for sales prospecting notes
projects.problem: reps kept prospect notes in spreadsheets that never synced
projects.approach: a Manifest V3 extension with a side panel, offline-first storage and sync to a Supabase backend
outcomes: 1,200 weekly active users after launch
Chrome Web Store rating of 4.7
projects.review: smooth extension, passed store review first time

projects.title: Performance rescue for a slow Laravel ecommerce site
projects.problem: checkout took 12 seconds during sales and the database CPU hit 100%
projects.approach: profiled queries, added indexes, removed N+1 loops and cached catalogue pages in Redis
outcomes: checkout time from 12 s to 1.6 s
database CPU at peak from 100% to 35%

projects.title: Progressive web app for offline field inspections
projects.problem: inspectors lost forms when the site had no signal
projects.approach: an offline-first PWA that queues inspections and photos locally and syncs when back online
outcomes: lost inspection reports dropped to zero
report turnaround from 3 days to same day
projects.review: works in basements with no signal, exactly as promised

projects.title: Auth overhaul with SSO and passkeys
projects.problem: enterprise prospects required SSO and the homegrown login had no MFA
projects.approach: moved login to a standard auth library with Google and SAML SSO, passkeys and session hardening
outcomes: closed two enterprise deals blocked on SSO
password reset tickets down 55%

projects.title: Analytics dashboard with charts and CSV exports
projects.problem: agronomists emailed spreadsheets around to compare field yields
projects.approach: a dashboard with yield maps, season comparisons and scheduled CSV exports backed by a FastAPI service
outcomes: weekly reporting time from 6 hours to 30 minutes
used by 85 agronomists
projects.review: exactly the charts our agronomists asked for

projects.title: Mobile app for a fitness studio chain
projects.problem: class bookings ran through WhatsApp groups
projects.approach: a cross-platform app with class booking, waitlists, payments and push reminders
outcomes: 4,000 downloads in the first two months
class fill rate up 18%
projects.review: members love the app and the waitlist feature

projects.title: LLM-powered support widget embedded in a web app
projects.problem: users could not find answers in 300 help-centre articles
projects.approach: an embedded chat widget with streaming answers grounded in help articles and a handoff to human support
outcomes: support tickets down 29%
answer helpfulness rated 4.4/5 by users
projects.review: our users get answers in seconds now
